newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnia April output slides 7.5 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia April output slides 7.5 pct m/m.

text.p: The Statistics Bureau of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Friday.
BOSNIA INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION APRIL MARCH APRIL 96

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of the territory of Bosnia-Hercegovina. No data are available for remaining 49 percent. Bosnian industrial output is up 49.1 percent in Jan-April period compared to the same period in 1996, but April 1997 production is down 88.3 percent compared to the prewar April 1991 output, the office said.
